name: Zurvan
source: Zurvan is the first Yazata [url=https://vndb.org/c111534]Quinn[/url] met and the same one who brought her to Wahman Yast. Although his martial prowess is close to [url=https://vndb.org/c111533]Magsarion[/url], his frivolous nature and behavior have gotten on everyone's nerves, making him rank #1 most hated members among the Yazata. Even though everyone hates him, he still puts on a wicked grin, ridiculing others around him.
